stemMarkdown: A student scored 270 marks in an exam and failed by 30 marks. If the pass mark is 50% of the maximum marks, what are the maximum marks?
solutionMarkdown: The pass mark is $270 + 30 = 300$. If the maximum is $M$, then $\dfrac{50}{100} \times M = 300$, so $M = \dfrac{300 \times 100}{50} = 600$.
